tasks.title: Track A: Multi-view sim2real consistency
tasks.details: 5 training approaches tried (v1–v5), all failed to achieve cross-camera consistency. Root cause: drop_ll makes global color independently random per camera; 12% FOV overlap too small to overcome 88% independent context. Concluded: noise-based training cannot fix LL independence. Next: synchronized denoising (inference-time warp-and-blend) or post-hoc color matching.

tasks.title: Track A: Synchronized denoising at inference
tasks.details: warp_and_blend_latents() already implemented in wavelet_noise_mv.py. Need: sim2real_nucarla_mv_sync.py (one shared denoising loop, per-step latent blend). No training needed. Directly addresses both HF and global color inconsistency.
